events.name: Play Time @ The Library – Oswestry
events.description: Free interactive sensory play session for children aged 0–5 and their grown-ups. Designed for children to explore, connect and grow together. Limited availability; booking is required with Oswestry Library staff by phone or email, or via the library’s Facebook page. Parental supervision is required.
events.age_guidance: Ages 0–5 with grown-ups; parental supervision required.

events.name: RBO: Manon (Ballet)
events.description: Royal Ballet and Opera presentation of Kenneth MacMillan's Manon.

events.name: Birdcatcher – Oswestry Memorial Hall
events.description: Pentabus production in association with Papatango Theatre Company and Middle Child. A darkly comic coming-of-age drama.
events.accessibility: Integrated audio description. Captions/subtitles can be offered through handheld devices at some performances; contact the venue in advance.

events.name: Wonderland Halloween Trick or Treat Day 2026
events.description: Runs every day 24–31 October 2026, 11:00–16:00, with last entry at 14:00. A Halloween Trick or Treat Day especially for younger children, with a treat trail and entertainers, tea party/disco, timed haunted-castle activity, scavenger hunt, spooky maze, five rides with unlimited use, colouring/gingerbread icing and an activity room. Pre-booking is required. Daytime admission is £17.50 adult or child; under-2s and wheelchair users are listed as free. Some optional extras cost more.
events.parking_transport: Wonderland says it has no own car park. Nearby pay-and-display options are South Water Ice Rink Car Park (TF3 4JQ), South Water Multi Storey (TF3 4HD) and Dark Lane (TF4 3GZ).
events.age_guidance: Especially for younger children; no specific age limit stated. Under-2s are free.

events.name: A Night of Music from Stage & Screen
events.description: Jackfield Brass Band and TACT ‘A Choired Taste’ Choir perform in aid of Children’s Services at the Shrewsbury and Telford Hospital NHS Trust.
events.source_name: Shrewsbury and Telford Hospital NHS Trust Charity

events.name: Library at the Lantern Writers Group – 29 Sep

events.name: Myths, Legends and Magic Trail – Shrewsbury Museum & Art Gallery
events.description: Runs 17–31 October 2026 over October half term. The official museum listing describes this as an All Day Event; no exact daily start/end times are published. Follow clues, find museum objects and complete a trail of magical stories and legendary characters. £1 per trail with a sticker reward. No booking needed; buy the trail on arrival. Museum admission is free.
